_comment: Realistic happy-path alert case for the alert-triage worked example. Drives the cross-target replay test under tests/examples/alert_triage/test_happy_path.py. Inputs are pinned so the canonical case-state JSON every target produces is deterministic byte-for-byte across replays. LM-touching steps (analyst free-text summary, DSPy signature in primitives/signatures.py) are out of scope here — this fixture exercises the CORE-bound deterministic primitives only: typed-payload validation (intake), canonical seen-key derivation (suppression check), and the prioritisation policy (classify and prioritise).
